headlines.title: 韩国今年超额税收收入预计将超过50万亿韩元
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月27日讯，据韩联社报道，韩国今年的超额税收收入可能超过50万亿韩元（约合370亿美元），这反映出半导体行业周期强于预期等因素。据韩联社计算，这可能会使未来应对基金（一种将超额税收收入用于战略投资和财政储备的政府工具）的规模超过200万亿韩元。报道称，经济财政部预计将在本月晚些时候发布的2026年修订版国家税收收入预测报告中公布这一数字。这笔意外之财将使政府有更多空间增加支出，而无需相应增加借贷。根据2027年的预算提案，半导体行业带来的这笔意外之财大部分将用于资助人工智能、芯片和青年发展，同时限制债券发行并建立财政缓冲。

headlines.title_en: South Korea's excess tax revenue is expected to exceed 50 trillion won this year
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 27 — According to Yonhap News Agency, South Korea's excess tax revenue this year may exceed 50 trillion won (about $37 billion), reflecting factors such as a stronger-than-expected semiconductor industry cycle. According to Yonhap calculations, this could push the size of the Future Response Fund, a government tool that uses excess tax revenue for strategic investment and fiscal reserves, above 200 trillion won. The report said the Ministry of Economy and Finance is expected to announce the figure in its revised 2026 national tax revenue forecast later this month. The windfall will give the government more room to increase spending without a corresponding rise in borrowing. Under the 2027 budget proposal, most of the semiconductor windfall will be used to fund artificial intelligence, chips and youth development, while limiting bond issuance and building fiscal buffers.

headlines.title_en: China Mobile, China Telecom and China Unicom jointly halt "zero-yuan phone" offers
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 27 — At the offline business halls of the three major telecom operators, many consumers have encountered promotions such as "get a free phone" or "free gifts with broadband." It appears that you can get a phone for free by signing up for a plan, but in reality you are signing a loan contract, with the monthly phone bill including repayment amounts. For a long time, this type of installment business has been a concentrated area of consumer complaints. Recently, reports said the three major operators have suspended such business. Calls to customer service for China Telecom and China Unicom, as well as customer service for China Mobile's "Hebao Credit Purchase," all received responses that such installment phone purchase programs have been suspended. Telecom analyst Fu Liang believes that the concentrated halt of financial installment phone purchase business by the three major operators, besides regulating related business practices, has a deeper background: the communications market has entered an era of stock, and the operating logic of relying on subsidizing phone hardware to attract users is no longer sustainable.

headlines.summary_en: In late New York trading on Friday (September 25), the benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yield fell 3.74 basis points to 5.1604%, having approached the second-quarter 2007 high of 5.3228% early in the U.S. stock session, up 16.44 basis points for the week, with overall trading in the 4.9204%-5.2254% range. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield fell 7.27 basis points to 4.8516%, continuing to expand losses after a gap lower at 08:00 Beijing time, overall holding steady near the September 23 high of 4.9409% (approaching the April 30, 2024 high of 5.0434%), up 10.83 basis points for the week, with overall trading in the 4.6990%-4.9409% range, fluctuating narrowly at lows on September 21-22 and then fluctuating narrowly at highs after a significant rise on the 23rd.

headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 27 — To ensure safety precautions during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holiday, the Work Safety Committee Office of the State Council, the National Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief Office, and the Ministry of Emergency Management recently deployed work teams across regions and industries during the holiday period, using the "four noes and two straights" method to conduct unannounced inspections in key industries, key venues and key locations, and to push for the implementation of various safety responsibility measures. On September 26, Song Yuanming, deputy director of the Work Safety Committee Office of the State Council and vice minister of the Ministry of Emergency Management, conducted video spot checks on the unannounced inspection work in five provinces or municipalities including Beijing, Liaoning, Shandong, Sichuan and Shaanxi, pushing localities to further strengthen safety precautions and make every effort to ensure safety and stability during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holiday.

headlines.title: 外交部：关于人工智能表述问题，中方重视美方立场也尊重美方提法
headlines.summary: 今天，外交部发言人就人工智能问题答记者问。 问：我们注意到，美方在介绍此次访问成果时，使用“超级智能”代替“人工智能”。请问中方有何评论？ 答：中美元首会晤时，就人工智能问题进行了深入讨论。关于人工智能表述问题，中方重视美方的立场，也尊重美方的提法。人工智能技术正在持续发展，各方可以结合最新形势，加强交流、深入探讨、寻求共识。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Regarding the wording on artificial intelligence, China values the US position and also respects the US formulation
headlines.summary_en: Today, a Foreign Ministry spokesperson answered a reporter's question on artificial intelligence. Q: We noted that when presenting the outcomes of this visit, the U.S. side used "superintelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence." What is China's comment? A: During the meeting between the Chinese and U.S. heads of state, the two sides held in-depth discussions on artificial intelligence. Regarding the wording on artificial intelligence, China values the U.S. position and respects the U.S. formulation. Artificial intelligence technology is continuing to develop, and all parties can, in light of the latest developments, strengthen exchanges, conduct in-depth discussions, and seek consensus. (CCTV News)
